name: SmartTagProperties
description: A collection of SmartTagProperty objects that represents the properties related to a smart tag.
remarks: To return the SmartTagProperties collection for a smart tag, use the Properties property of the SmartTag object. To create a custom property from within a Visual Basic for Applications (VBA) project, use the Add method of the SmartTagProperties collection.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Use the Application property to access the active Microsoft Access Application object and its related properties. Read-only Application object.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Use the Count property to determine the number of items in a specified collection. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: Item
properties.description: The Item property returns a specific member of a collection either by position or by index. Read-only SmartTagProperty.

methods.name: Add
methods.signature: Add(Name As String, Value As Variant) As _SmartTagProperty
methods.description: Adds a custom property to a smart tag.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name to be used for the custom property.

parameters.name: Value
parameters.description: The value of the custom property.
